text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew… Thanks for inviting me out here. I needed a break.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I've had so much on my mind recently that it's been affecting my performance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Things like the most effective way to prepare for my next race or if I'm working hard enough on my winning equation…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Speaking of equations, I wonder if Ticket was able to use the one I taught her the other day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And where's that Taishin? I haven't seen her this morning. Oh, I hope she isn't laid up in bed because she overworked herself!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Anxious as ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If you think I'm playing hooky, I'm not. I'm just taking a breather before the student council meeting starts.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What a coincidence. We came here to take a break too.
choice_data_list: Why don't we all pay a visit to the shrine together?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That would be wonder—oh, but Brian has a meeting soon. Maybe we shouldn't bother her…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's no skin off my back. I still have time before I have to go.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Really? Thanks so much, you two. This will be a nice little break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of us pray at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What's so funny?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Nothing… Praying here with you just reminds me of that one time when we were younger.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What did you pray for this year, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: I prayed to become as fast as you! What'd you pray for?

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I prayed that we'll always be able to race together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That was forever ago. I don't remember anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I still remember like it was yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It was. I'm glad I was able to remember my wish too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're so simple sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that with this little outing, Biwa Hayahide is feeling better than ever!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Urgh… This is no good. The more I try not to think about it, the more I do!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't waste your breath. There's no stopping her once she starts spiraling.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian! I worry about you too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I constantly worry about how you're doing in school and if you're eating and resting properl—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't you run away! You come back here and listen to me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm not trying to run away! I have a student council meeting, remember?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This shrine visit doesn't end up helping Biwa Hayahide relax at all…
